deleteVoiceDescription: Delete this archived voice and all of its revisions. A voice used by a project cannot be deleted.
scriptPlaceholder: Enter the script for this revision
roleBindingsHint: Each role is bound once to an immutable voice revision for this project revision.
audiobookConfigurationInvalid: This pre-release audiobook revision has no valid role bindings. Import or rebuild the script, then save a new revision.
pronunciationHint: Replace names or terms with the exact reading used during synthesis.
pronunciationInvalid: Complete every entry and remove duplicate words.
voiceAuthorization: I have permission to use this voice
designDescription: Describe the voice, delivery, age range, and tone
candidateAuditionRequired: Play the candidate through once before saving this voice.
referenceRequirements: Use 5–30 seconds of clean speech. Audio is converted to mono and normalized locally.
candidateSample: Welcome. This sample checks clarity, pacing, names, numbers, and natural sentence endings before you save the voice.
noVoices: No voice profiles in this Space.
sourceSeparationDescription: Create a local background candidate. Spleeter separates vocals from accompaniment and does not guarantee spoken-dialogue removal.
sourceSeparationReviewWarning: Spleeter separates vocals from accompaniment and does not guarantee spoken-dialogue removal. Audition the full candidate before accepting it.
sourceSeparationTooLong: Source separation supports up to 10 minutes. Split the video before creating a background candidate.
separationAuditioned: I auditioned the full background candidate

separationStatus.accepted: This background candidate is accepted for mixing.

videoSourcesHint: Choose analyzed media already imported into this Space. Original audio is muted; background audio must be an independent recording.
videoTimingRule: Keep each line within its target interval. A duration fit outside 0.90–1.10 requires editing. Overlapping lines retain their own tracks.
localTranslationUnavailable: No local translation model is configured. Enter the target-language script or configure a loopback Ollama model.
needsTimingEdit: The generated speech does not fit this target interval. Adjust the text or interval, then save a new revision.
author: Author
signalAdvisory: Signal findings are listening cues, not a score of voice naturalness. Intentional pauses can be flagged.
signalNoFindings: No signal anomalies found in the scanned interval.
signalTruncated: Inspection is limited to two hours and 100 findings.
previewText: Enter up to 500 characters to audition this voice
retainOriginalTrack: Include original audio as a separate track
preserveOriginalOutsideDialogue: Preserve original sound outside source dialogue intervals
subtitleBeyondSource: Subtitle timing exceeds the source video.
mixedVoiceBindings: Multiple voices; select a shared voice
audioTracksHint: Select up to eight published revisions of the same source video, in playback track order.
coverRequiresEncodedOutput: Choose MP3 or M4B to embed a cover.
referenceNodeChanged: The audio node source changed. Refresh the node before preparing a voice reference.
